          The Surrey M25, A3, M3 and M23 roadworks and closures for drivers to avoid this week

          There are a significant number of roadworks taking place this week

          News
          Victoria Shipp
          16:25, 28 Sep 2026
          Listen to audio version of this article
          Sponsored by
          0:00 / 6:03
          Instaread

          There will be plenty of roadworks across Surrey this week as National Highways carries out a significant amount of work.

          ‌

          The A3, M3, M23 and the M25 will all see some disruption over the coming days, as highways workers trim back trees, repair safety fences and resurface. This will mean diversion routes and longer journeys for many.

          ‌

          The roadworks will take place overnight, between 8pm-6am, meaning that peak time motorists will be unaffected.

          ‌

          Take a look at the scheduled works.
